title: OpenVA Agent Enrichment Row
description: The shared, transport-neutral vendor-identity row. This is the contract genuinely common to both enrichment surfaces: the MCP enrich_inventory tool wraps a list of these rows under `rows`, and the match-service /v1/enrich HTTP endpoint wraps the same rows under `vendors`. A row carries only bounded vendor-identity fields and an opaque row_id; additionalProperties is false so unrelated workspace columns and resolver internals cannot enter OpenVA. At least one identity field must be non-empty (enforced by each transport). Specific identifiers such as business_entity_name or registration_number may resolve to one entity when evidence supports it; vague brand-only rows may return candidate state in the result contract instead of expanding this input template.

row_id.description: Opaque caller correlation id. Echoed verbatim; never interpreted as a workspace identifier.

registration_number.description: Matched via legal-entity resolution on any surface that carries legal-entity data for the vendor (the match service over a catalogue pack; the MCP snapshot over the vendor export's legal_entities) using one shared fallback. Registration-number matching is scoped to the specific legal entity; it does not collapse a global brand into one contracting entity.
